sources.title: GLM 4.7 Flash — Fast Multilingual LLM | ModelsLab
sources.snippet: What is Z.ai GLM 4.7 Flash and how does it differ from the full GLM 4.7 model? GLM 4.7 Flash is a 30-billion parameter optimized variant with only 3 billion active parameters, delivering faster inference while maintaining strong performance. The full GLM 4.7 offers higher capability but requires more compute resources.
